Hymn 6: Redeemer of Israel
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Freeman Lewis
Lyricist/Text Author: William W. Phelps
Category: Restoration

This is hymn number 6 titled "Redeemer of Israel" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Freeman Lewis and the lyrics were written by William W. Phelps.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
